focus: Dead documents: references, assets, examples and playbooks nothing loads
keyFindings: No dead document exists in either in-scope packet. All 73 leaves exist, the 64 reference and asset files in the two owner packets are exactly the leaf list with no file outside it, both lane tables cover every leaf through a named file or a named directory, all three playbook indexes link every scenario on disk (52 of 52, 52 of 52, 7 of 7), the 35 company fixtures are named by the scenarios that use them, and the 29 packet changelog notes are linked from README and SKILL.md. Fix: none. A markdown link graph is the wrong reachability test here and would delete the routing sources if trusted: 549 files have no inbound markdown link, including every routed reference, every asset and every playbook scenario, because the runtime reaches them through leaf-manifest.json, the ROUTER map and the lane tokens, not through prose links. The authoritative tests are those three, and only folders outside the packets (playbooks, changelog, benchmark) are fairly judged by links. Fix: none; record the method so a future cleanup does not run an orphan-link delete. The 21 example knowledge mirrors are reachable only by a naming convention, never by name: no non-knowledge file mentions any of them, and the kernel reaches all 21 through one group row plus the rule that titles read Examples - {Kind} - {Descriptor}. A renamed example silently falls out of retrieval and no gate in the sync loop would notice, because the format gate reads the kernel and the drift comparison reads file names only. Fix: add a check that every knowledge file still matches the prefix pattern the kernel states. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/Custom Instructions.md:222-224] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/README.md:49-53]

The hub's own release note is the one document with no inbound link: README links the packet's latest note and describes the hub changelog folder in the tree, but never links changelog/v1.0.0.0.md, so the file is reachable only by browsing the folder. Fix: link it from the README release line beside the packet note. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/README.md:768] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/README.md:926] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/changelog/v1.0.0.0.md:1-5]

Thirteen in-scope files write template placeholders as markdown links, so a link checker reports 14 broken links that are not drift: task-templates.md alone has three forms of [{name}](figma-url). No link gate can be added to the repository until these are exempted or rewritten, which is why link integrity is unverified today while every other document claim is gated. Fix: write placeholders as code spans or angle-bracket URLs, then add a link check to run_gates.sh. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/assets/task-templates.md:57] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/assets/story-template.md:1-40]

The vendored mcp-code-mode packet carries 13 genuinely broken links: its doctor commands point at ../../../../commands/doctor/mcp.md, which resolves to AI Systems/commands/doctor/, while the real file sits under .skilled/commands/doctor/. A reader of those playbooks cannot open the command they test. Fix: correct the path upstream in the shared skill and pull it through scripts/vendor-sync.py; editing the copy here would be reverted by the next pull. [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/mcp-code-mode/manual-testing-playbook/doctor-commands/doctor-mcp-debug.md:80] [SOURCE: AI Systems/Product Owner/scripts/vendor-sync.py:1-30]

references/routing.md is the one reference file with no lane token: the three lane rows name the other eleven references and both asset templates, while routing.md appears only in prose after the table and in the hub ROUTER's keyword note. A reader who loads lanes mechanically never opens the file that holds the routing steps, the confidence thresholds and the Story shape rules. Fix: add it to the ALWAYS or CONDITIONAL row.
